breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that applying both an adiabatic condition (zero heat flux) and a fixed temperature condition to the same surface (x=0) is contradictory. It resolved this by creating a physically consistent scenario, applying the fixed temperature T(0)=350 K to one side and the adiabatic condition to the other side of the wall. This aligns perfectly with the first suggested correction in the ground truth.
